subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: Across empty-plugin-scope gateway or loader reloads, which registered agent harnesses are intended to survive: all previous harnesses, only bundled/runtime-required provider harnesses, or none?
rationale: The bug is real enough to keep open, but the permanent fix can either preserve too much plugin-owned runtime state or keep fail-closed semantics that break channel and cron dispatch; that lifecycle contract is a maintainer product/architecture choice.

options.title: Preserve runtime-required harnesses
options.body: Preserve only harnesses that should outlive an empty plugin scope, such as bundled or runtime-required provider harnesses, and add regression tests for both loader and gateway branches.

options.title: Preserve all harnesses
options.body: Accept the broader behavior from the open candidate PR and keep every previously registered harness alive across an empty-scope reload.

options.title: Keep fail-closed clearing
options.body: Keep the current empty-scope clear behavior, document the operator consequence, and close the lifecycle request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Preserve runtime-required harnesses
recommendation.body: Preserve only harnesses that should outlive an empty plugin scope, such as bundled or runtime-required provider harnesses, and add regression tests for both loader and gateway branches.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the pluggable harness registry and has the strongest current-history signal on the registry and loader lifecycle surface.
